description: One row per screening answer a lead gave on an externally authored form. The question is kept exactly as it was asked and is mapped to nothing: `question_hash` is its stable identity, `question` the key the form sent, and `label` the wording the patient actually saw. What a patient was asked and what they answered are both facts about that patient, so the row is self-describing and stays readable after its form is gone.

fields.label: Question
fields.description: The wording the patient saw, as the form presented it.

fields.label: Answer
fields.description: The answer as given. A multi-select answer holds every value, joined with a comma.

fields.label: Question Key
fields.description: The question key the external form sent, stored whole and never shortened.

fields.label: Question Hash
fields.description: The identity a query matches on: a fixed-length digest of the question key, so the index never depends on a length that a longer question could one day exceed. Set on write; never edited.

fields.label: Form
fields.description: The form this answer was given on.

name: CRM Lead Screening Answer
